title: Aliens Are Losing Their Patience
text: People are not being punished for the crime of dumping these toxic chemicals onto children, onto people. No one's knocking on their door telling them to stop because there is no door. There is no door to knock on. There's no way to find them. There is nobody to hold accountable. One of the problems with this is they're seen as a free radical. And so it's really a matter of time before one of these spaceships, one of these alien crafts, one of these extraterrestrials says enough is enough and starts to eradicate the chemtrail planes and starts to eradicate the geoengineering planes because aliens are using the same airspace. They're flying through it and they don't want to see that. There's going to come a time where there's going to be a rogue alien that's going to say, "Time to put the foot down. Time to stop whatever this is. This isn't helping human beings down there. It's not helping us as we're flying through it. It's dangerous. It's traffic that's in our way. An alien craft that's traveling at an extremely high warp speed can accidentally run into one of these chemtrail planes. So, I wouldn't doubt at all that some of these chemtrail planes or a lot of them start either disappearing or going down because of extraterrestrials acting as vigilantes. [Music]
